lumenby: LUMENBY QUARRY, an abandoned neon-tube quarry town at dusk: rust and ochre stepped stone terraces cut into a pit, wooden haul ramps, mine carts, a dark hillside with a huge broken neon sign whose letters are unlit, timber shacks being rebuilt, glowing cyan ore veins in the rock, a pickaxe leaning on a crate.
underglow: THE UNDERGLOW, a vast round shaft deep underground spiralling downward in ledges, lit from below by a warm golden 'sun below', glowing violet crystals, fossil arcade cabinets embedded in rock, rope lifts and glowsticks marking the way, a sense of great depth.
seterfell: SETER FELL, Norwegian summer mountain farm high on the fell in late summer: turf-roofed log huts, stone fences, grazing goats, birch trees, a blue lake, grey boulders that look like sleeping trolls with moss and tiny trees on their backs, low golden evening sun.
yulefjord: YULE FJORD, polar night in a snowy Norwegian fishing village by a frozen fjord: red boathouses on stilts, a small stave church, lanterns glowing gold in the blue darkness, green and violet aurora over the mountains, ice floes, a lighthouse beam.
stillsand: STILLSAND, a pastel desert just after sunrise in a Moebius-like mood: peach and rose dunes, floating violet stone islands hovering over the sand each with one tree and a glowing gold quartz in its roots, old white garden robots tending flowers, a lone silent rider on a stone bird.
sporelight: SPORELIGHT, a giant glowing fungus forest under a drifting spore haze: teal and violet bioluminescent mushrooms as big as trees, moss, floating glowing spores, a huge gentle six-legged grazer creature with calm cyan eyes, a wooden spirit bathhouse with lanterns in the distance.
fogstage: FOGSTAGE, a lowland drowned in pink stage fog with hilltop towns rising out of it like theatre sets: painted flat-backdrop houses, stage spotlights on poles, ropes and sandbags, a theatre blimp moored at a hill, wind-up puppet townsfolk.
rerun: RERUN ESTATES, a sunny 1980s suburban cul-de-sac: trimmed lawns, pastel houses with garages, a red phone booth glowing, mailboxes, a flamingo lawn ornament, sprinklers, a station wagon in a driveway, a lawnmower, cheerful but slightly uncanny.
